about: The chaos suite's legs (C14 brief, amended 2026-10-20): each harness/cases/<case>.sh, variant and repeat is one leg of chaos.yml. The restart cases run 3 times and run-chaos.sh prints the worst outage. n is the brief's case number. `owed` (C14 fix round 3, item 4) names the docs/_INDEX.md Owed row behind each check a leg is known to fail (a row, or a list tried in order), so run-chaos.sh's table says which reds are explained; it never changes a verdict, and an owed red is as red as any other. A row is named for a failed check only when its `owed_signatures` filter (jq over that leg's verdict.json, its measures the evidence of the row's own cause) holds in that run (fix round 4, the re-review's I-3); else the check reads NOT OWED with the signature absent.

owed_signatures.70 (a): .measures.deaths_logged as $d | ($d.kills | type) == "number" and ($d.needs | type) == "number" and $d.kills >= $d.needs and ($d.counted_max // 0) < $d.needs

owed_titles.70 (a): the 1 s child poll counts a fast GPU-death loop late (5 kills in about 330 ms, 1 counted), so nothing restarts
owed_titles.84: a sink that connects after the fault clears replays its backlog, and the recorder discards it
owed_titles.85: CEF never starts again after a container restart, so the overlay stays off
owed_titles.86: the ladder never moves under CPU starvation, and the beats read healthy
owed_titles.87: the stall rule never swaps the sink: rtmp2sink's own 5 s socket timeout fails it first, and `sink swap` names no reason
